jobs_results.title: IOS Developer (Hybrid)
jobs_results.description:
Mediktor is looking for a Senior iOS Developer to join our Agile team in charge of the continuous improvements of our product as well as the development and support of our different customer integrations.

About us:

Mediktor has developed an artificial intelligence based medical assistant capable of simulating a conversation with a real doctor. This can lead to enormous cost savings, process optimization and waiting time reduction in many healthcare use cases, for example in triage for emergency departments or medical call centers.

Our technology uses natural language recognition, multiple types of prediction models, and can be integrated into almost any type of solution thanks to our UI libraries and our wide range of API methods and capabilities.

The software has been clinically validated with a success rate of up to 91.3% in trials with real patients.

😉 You can try our showcase application by yourself, and we will surely appreciate your feedback:
• Mediktor in the Apple App... Store
• Mediktor in the Google Play Store
• Mediktor B2C web portal

We invite you to be part of the team of one of the most important technology startups in the ehealth sector. We are a Barcelona-based startup and we are growing! We are looking for motivated individuals that want to help us improve access to healthcare all over the world. 💥

About the team:

You will be integrated in a team that is moving towards Agility. As a startup company, we are fast-learners, and we welcome new ideas and points of view, so you can help us in the shaping of our Scrum framework and methodologies. You will be part of our rituals: daily meetings, Sprint planning, Spikes, Retros, refinements, regular brainstorming sessions and after-work beers once per month! If you want to be part of a team that is constantly improving where we value transparency, commitment, energy and good vibes, do not hesitate to join us. In our constantly growing environment, we are improving and we need you to help us!

What you will be doing:

One of your initial tasks will be to migrate/recreate our existing app from Objective-C to a Hybrid Swift UI + WebView application, taking maximum advantage of native functionalities when it’s needed, and leaving the rest to the WebApp. This will give you the opportunity to adapt our product to top-trend libraries and best practices, while being able to deliver fully-featured products to our customers during the journey. You will have a lot of freedom over what technologies to use, how to apply them, to discuss the roadmap, and generally improving access to healthcare together with us.

Other tasks that you will be doing:
• Develop iOS projects from inception to final delivery autonomously.
• Maintenance and further improvements in all the projects & products during
• post-production phase. We currently have 40+ customers.
• Cooperate closely with other team members (backend, Android, web, UX/UI,
• QA)
• Contribute to build clean code with proper unit tests to keep code optimised
• Co-develop with our DevOps team automated cloud pipelines for iOs testing and delivery
• Participate in code reviews and pair programming
• Keep up with technological advances to optimise our software
• Communicate effectively of new technology trends to decision makers

What you need to have:
• Minimum experience: 3 years in iOS development doing similar functions as specified in the job description (both Swift and Objective-C)
• High generic object oriented development skills
• Software architectural and pattern knowledge and proven application of such
• Deep knowledge of the inner guts of the iOs platform
• Knowledge of the current trends of iOs frameworks
• Experience and knowledge of WebView management & communication
• Knowledge in automated testing and QA procedures
• Knowledge of responsibility management
• Excellent communication skills (English & Spanish)

What will make you shine:
• Experience developing and delivering iOs SDKs and/or libraries
• Experience with Hybrid iOs-WebApp applications
• Experience automating iOs build/delivery operations
• Experience managing iOs AppStore applications
• Experience developing iOs animations, with or without frameworks
• Experience developing server RESTful API based applications, using OpenAPI and reactive architectures
• Experience in Agile methodologies
• Experience working in team-oriented, collaborative environment
• Experience in startup environment
• Highly self-motivated and independent
• Positive attitude, team-player.

What you will find working with Mediktor:

💎 An exciting scale-up company sharing good vibes

🚀 Opportunity to grow and develop your career with us

🏡 Flexible hours and hybrid model of work (2 on site, 3 days at home)

👩👦👦 Excellent multicultural and teamwork environment

🏢 Amazing offices in an important historic center of the city located in the Modernist Campus of Hospital Sant Pau. Our rooftop views are one of the best in the city

🥗 Access to cheap meals in our canteen

💰 Competitive salary conditions

🎒 Mediktor welcome pack

🅿 Parking discounts around the office

💚 Health insurance package

💚 Cobee Card
• Mediktor is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status

jobs_results.title: Senior iOS Developer
jobs_results.description:
What we offer
• Remote work from home, except for client or internal company meetings /events that require physical attendance
• The opportunity to work for a successful international e-commerce company with an open and proactive culture.
• The opportunity to work closely with different areas in ONCE.
• The opportunity to leave your mark in one of the most relevant world lottery operators while supporting a good cause that helps thousands of impaired people.
• A role in an open and friendly work environment with a level of responsibility.

Your tasks
• This will include collaborating with Product Owner and UX Design colleagues to deliver inspirational games apps and continue to optimize their performance post release.
• A key part of this role will be to develop and produce functional solutions with quality designs and code in accordance with architecture design standards, code standards and environment configuration management.
• Being responsible for the whole product lifecycle... (development, testing deployment, operations, and monitoring), together with your team.
• Perform code-reviews and pair programming to share your knowledge.

What you offer us
• +4 years' experience in iOS development (Xcode, ObjectiveC, Swift, JSON, REST).
• Experience using MVVM and familiarity with other iOS Architecture patterns.
• A good understanding of iOS UX/UI guidelines/best practices and the ability to engage with the creative team to deliver pragmatic solutions, balancing design, quality and velocity.
• Experience writing apps using SwiftUI and Combine.
• Flair for clean code, testability, reusability, and readability (SOLID, TDD).
• Experience of writing User Interface Tests using XCUITests.
• Solid understanding and practical knowledge of the full mobile development and application lifecycle.
• Experience with mobile development issues related to performance optimisation, caching, security and native components / SDK's.
• Working knowledge of the general mobile landscape, architectures, trends and emerging technologies.
• Excellent communication skills across all levels of the organisation and external 3rd parties / suppliers.
• Enjoy working within self-organized teams with an eagerness for responsibility.
• Excellent communication skills and proficient in English and Spanish

jobs_results.title: Desarrolladores Mobile (IOS & Android)
jobs_results.description:
¿De qué va la empresa en la que trabajarás?

Somos una empresa de soluciones móviles corporativas, la cual desde hace 10 años viene centrado su misión en acelerar la digitalización tecnológica de la sociedad, desarrollamos tanto webs como apps híbridas.

En estos años nuestro equipo ha dado forma a más de 1000 proyectos para 150 clientes con presencia nacional e internacional.

¿En qué creemos?

Nos basamos en cuatro valores fundamentales:
• Innovación, ofreciendo soluciones innovadoras de una manera profesional y rentable con un valor diferencial: el conocimiento experto en toda la cadena de valor.
• Compromiso ya que llevamos como propios los objetivos de la organización y superamos cualquier obstáculo para lograrlos.
• Proactividad, proveyendo y realizando acciones para mejorar sus servicios y calidad.
• Trabajo en equipo, contando con un equipo motivado y multidisciplinar que trabaja en perfecta coordinación para lograr los objetivos comunes.

Requisitos:

Buscamos gente como tú... para trabajar en distintos proyectos Mobile en distintas ubicaciones y/o en remoto.

Nos gustaría que fueras un compañero con:
• Perfil con 2 - 3 años de experiencia
• Experiencia en alguna/as de estas herramientas o entornos IOS, Android, React, Angular, GIT, Swift / SwiftU, API´s RESTful, Objective-C ......
• Experiencia trabajando con metodología agile
• Inglés será un plus

¿Cómo será tu día a día en Slash?
• Participarás en proyectos para diferentes clientes y con diferente alcance. ¡Apostamos a qué no te aburrirás!
• Trabajarás con metodologías ágiles.
• Estarás en un equipo que valora las ideas y propuestas de los otros. En búsqueda de constante mejora.
• Diseñarás vistas con auto layouts.
• Realizarás estimaciones de proyectos, auditorías de aplicaciones y gestionarás bugs y errores.
• Colaborarás con diferentes compañeros en función del proyecto, conocerás (si es nueva para ti) la metodología squads.
• Tendrás a disposición diferentes opciones para formarte y seguir creciendo como profesional.

¡Formarás parte de un equipo al que le gusta trabajar bien pero pasarlo mejor!

El SlashTeam te está esperando

jobs_results.title: iOS Developer. Up to 50K. 📱
jobs_results.description:
I am looking for an iOS programmer for one of my clients. A french company leader in its sector to participate in mobile projects. 🙌

Your main tasks will be: 📱

● Design, develop, and deploy high-quality iOS applications using best development practices and meeting project deadlines.

● Work with multiple design patterns such as VIPER, MVVM, MVP, MVC, etc., depending on project requirements.

● Participate in the design and software architecture of iOS applications.

● Following best practices in iOS development and emerging technological trends.

Requirements: 🚀

●Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in iOS app development, with strong proficiency in Swift.

● In-depth knowledge of key iOS design patterns such as VIPER, MVVM, MVC, etc., and the ability to effectively implement them.

jobs_results.title: iOS Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Quantion is a Business Digital Transformation services company born in 2015.

We have +120 professionals in application development, UX/UI and digital business transformation to build innovative solutions oriented to business results.

We combine our teams in cutting-edge technologies and digital deep experiences with the innovation ecosystem, to ensure that we can provide the best solution to face business challenges, from its concept to its implementation.

We are looking for a Senior iOS Developer for an airline project.

The project focuses on improving the passenger experience throughout the entire journey. The projects we focus on are the main web portals, mobile apps (iOS and Android) and B2B platforms of the client. In addition, we are developing our own R&D solutions within the company initiatives.

We are focused on the continuous development of our software engineers and therefore you can expect:
• Experienced developers to learn from,
• Weekly dev talks, time... for refactoring and improvements,
• Dev team has freedom to choose frameworks/libraries,
• Individual development plan with trainings,
• Possibility to go to conferences.

Our technology stack: Swift 5; Xcode 13; SPM; UIKit & SwiftUI; Combine; Quick & Nimble for testing; GIT; Fastlane; Core Data; communication with REST API; XCTest; Wiremock; Azure Devops.

If you are interested in joining a group of software enthusiasts, working in an international agile team setup, creating products that make the difference in the entire airline industry - then apply now!

What do we expect?
• At least 5 years of experience on a similar position,
• Experience in Swift,
• Practical knowledge of design & UX patterns,
• Experience in workflow tools (Jira),
• Experience in Continuous Integration,
• Good English skills for daily communication,
• Enthusiasm, curiosity and creativity,
• Team spirit,
• Open mind and open communication,
• Solution oriented working,
• Motivation to bring yourself and the team a step further.

What do we welcome?
• Experience in working in Scrum/SAFe,
• Work experience in international environment.

Our offering:

✨ Permanent contract

✨ 22 days of vacation

✨ 5 additional holidays for Christmas

✨ 4 additional holidays for Easter

✨ Flexible working time

✨ Flexible remuneration: Health insurance

✨ Hybrid work: 2 office days and 3 telework days

✨ Continuous working days in summer

✨ Travel opportunities

✨ An international working environment, atmosphere that stimulates development,

✨ Individual career path

Committed to equality, at Quantion we believe in diversity and inclusion. We defend equal opportunities without discriminating based on gender, age, religion or sexual orientation or any other aspect that could be considered exclusive

jobs_results.title: TÉCNICO/A INFORMÁTICA DESARROLLADOR/A iOS SWIFT
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

Mercadona, empresa de capital familiar, es una de las principales compañías de supermercados físicos y de venta online en España.

Actualmente nos encontramos inmersos en un Plan de Transformación Digital con el que buscamos agilizar al máximo la toma de decisiones, incrementando la eficiencia y agilidad de los procesos a través de datos de calidad, para seguir mejorando el servicio que damos a nuestros clientes y otros componentes de la compañía.

Desarrollador informática

Qué te ofrecemos :

En este puesto dispondrás de :
• Proyectos innovadores de alta relevancia en la empresa, trabajando con tecnologías punteras
• Formación continua adaptada a tus necesidades y promoción interna
• Aprendizaje constante formando parte de un equipo experimentado dentro del Departamento de Informática
• Buen ambiente de trabajo y seguridad laboral
• Contacto directo con los mejores proveedores especialistas

Requisitos :
• Ciclos Formativos de Grado Superior Informática o... Telecomunicaciones
• Experiencia de al menos 1 año en desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles para iOS con Swift
• Disponibilidad horaria de lunes a viernes
• Carné de conducir y vehículo propio
• Capacidad de comunicación y trabajo en equipo
• Pasión e interés por las nuevas tecnologías

Conocimientos específicos

Se valorará conocimientos y / o formación en :
• Grado de Ingeniería Informática o de Telecomunicaciones
• Uso de APIs JSON-REST
• Herramientas de control de versiones (Git) e integración continua
• Control de calidad (test)
• Buenas prácticas de programación (Clean Code, patrones de diseño, etc.)
• Gestión de certificados y perfiles en App Store Connect de Apple

Tareas
• Desarrollar funcionalidades para las nuevas aplicaciones nativas que se implanten con un número elevado de usuarios y una alta criticidad
• Realizar el mantenimiento de las apps encontrando las causas de los bugs y desarrollando parches y mejoras para su corrección
• Analizar los requisitos planteados y diseñar e implementar las mejores soluciones posibles
• Garantizar el rendimiento, la calidad y la capacidad de respuesta de las apps iOS desarrolladas con Swift

Idiomas

Inglés B2

#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero de desarrollo iOS con experiencia
jobs_results.description:
Sobre Nomasystems:

Qué hacemos: Desde 2004, hemos estado diseñando soluciones de software sólidas, eficientes y de alto rendimiento, especializándonos en servicios y aplicaciones móviles, para algunas de las corporaciones más grandes del mundo.

Nuestras aplicaciones móviles nativas, usadas por más de 100 millones de usuarios activos, han aparecido en la lista de destacados de la App Store más de 20 veces.

Nuestros principios: Nomasystems es una comunidad de personas autónomas, innovadoras y socialmente responsables que valoran el crecimiento personal, la excelencia y un estilo de vida equilibrado. Es una organización donde la voz de cada individuo importa y donde cada miembro del equipo es una parte vital del crecimiento reflexivo y sostenible de la empresa.

Requisitos mínimos Imprescindibles del puesto :

Licenciado/grado Ingeniería informática, ingeniero de telecomunicaciones, física o matemáticas, o ingeniero técnico informática de gestión o de sistemas. Con conocimientos... demostrables de:
• o Fundamentos de la ingeniería del software en aspectos como las redes TCP/IP, bases de datos y diseño de software.
• o Mobile: Swift, Swift UI, Guidelines de Apple y Material Design.
• o TDD.
• o Trabajo con repositorios GIT y herramientas de control de versiones.

Experiencia mínima de 2 años como desarrollador iOS. Swift / Swift UI.

NIF o NIE, permiso de trabajo España.

Condiciones de trabajo:
• Trabajo 100% remoto.
• Horario flexible. 2 limitaciones: coincidir el 50% del tiempo con tu equipo de trabajo habitual y no trabajar en horario nocturno.
• Jornada intensiva la mayor parte del tiempo, no solo en verano o los viernes.
• 23 días laborables de vacaciones, + el 24 y 31 de diciembre no laborables, + 5 días libres adicionales cada año.
• Seguro médico privado a partir del sexto mes. No es retribución flexible, lo paga la empresa de forma adicional al salario, e incluye pareja legal e hijos/as
